purpose: ReguLens synthetic evidence integrity audit, not FDA approval or full eCTD compliance

authorities.notes: FDA draft, recommendations only; tailored to context of use and model risk
IND pharmacology/toxicology context; package is pre-IND and incomplete; not scored for compliance.

scoping.missing_documentation_means: Not located in the supplied package; human review needed, not automatically a deficiency
scoping.source_integrity: Every finding source quote must be verified against uploaded content before rendering.

rules.name: Proposed-use model version
rules.scientific_meaning: Two documents explicitly identify the same model for the same proposed use but with conflicting version identifiers.
rules.detection_criteria: model_name + proposed-use role + explicit versions, source quotes
rules.required_evidence: Source quotes documenting named model and proposed-use version from two sources.
rules.example: Model identity in summary v2.1 vs intended-use model card v2.0
rules.severity_rationale: Material conflict likely to mislead a decision about this specific evidence package.

expected_output.recommendation: Reconcile model identity and update source documents; do not flag historical versions.

rules.regulatory_status: Scientific/document consistency check; no invented FDA legal requirement

rules.name: Same-context performance mismatch
rules.scientific_meaning: Two reported values disagree for the same model, model version, endpoint, dataset, evaluation split, metric definition and relevant units, or a reported value differs from independently recomputed counts.
rules.detection_criteria: Same evaluation identity, two metric quotes and/or TP/FN/TN/FP counts
rules.required_evidence: Comparable endpoint/model/version/cohort/split/metric definition plus original numbers, units, and source quotes.
rules.example: Sensitivity 0.95 in summary vs 0.80 in validation report and 32/(32+8)=0.80
rules.severity_rationale: Material conflict likely to mislead a decision about this specific evidence package.

expected_output.recommendation: Recalculate and reconcile sensitivity; preserve both quoted sources.

rules.regulatory_status: Scientific/document consistency check; no invented FDA legal requirement

rules.name: Evidence contradiction
rules.scientific_meaning: An assertion of independent external validation conflicts with explicit evidence specifying only within-institution testing. Missing evidence alone requires human review.
rules.detection_criteria: Assertion quote plus evidence quote, same model/use
rules.required_evidence: Assertion of external validation and explicit, source-backed record of where test data originated.
rules.example: Summary: validated at independent external laboratory; report: not external-laboratory dataset
rules.severity_rationale: Material conflict likely to mislead a decision about this specific evidence package.

expected_output.recommendation: Clarify test location and replace/withdraw unsupported external-validation claim.

regulatory_sources.usage: context-specific review recommendation; not mandatory regulation

rules.regulatory_status: Context-dependent draft guidance only; not a finding of FDA noncompliance

rules.name: Acceptance-criteria review
rules.scientific_meaning: Scoped documentation review explicitly finds no prespecified, context-appropriate performance acceptance criteria in provided package.
rules.detection_criteria: Reviewed package scope; explicit negative/absence marker and no positive evidence
rules.required_evidence: Explicit scoped documentation review and evidence that criteria are absent in uploaded material, not merely omitted by extraction.
rules.example: Validation report says no prespecified performance acceptance criteria recorded
rules.severity_rationale: Documentation or attachment is unclear or unavailable within the small uploaded package; requires follow-up.

expected_output.recommendation: Provide dated prospectively defined criteria appropriate to the context of use, or explain their absence.

rules.name: Performance uncertainty review
rules.scientific_meaning: Scoped documentation review identifies missing uncertainty estimates for reported performance.
rules.detection_criteria: Reviewed package; explicit negative/missing marker and no positive estimates
rules.required_evidence: Explicit scoped documentation review of performance uncertainty, no contrary positive evidence.
rules.example: Validation report says confidence intervals not presented
rules.severity_rationale: Documentation or attachment is unclear or unavailable within the small uploaded package; requires follow-up.

expected_output.recommendation: Report interpretable performance uncertainty and method; qualified scientist review.

rules.name: Limitations and bias review
rules.scientific_meaning: Scoped documentation review identifies no limitations, applicability, representativeness or bias discussion.
rules.detection_criteria: Reviewed package; explicit negative marker and no countervailing discussion
rules.required_evidence: Explicit scoped review of model limitations and bias documentation, no contrary positive evidence.
rules.example: Model card says limitations and biases not documented here
rules.severity_rationale: Documentation or attachment is unclear or unavailable within the small uploaded package; requires follow-up.

expected_output.recommendation: Describe limitations, out-of-distribution risks and label bias.

rules.name: Model-risk review
rules.scientific_meaning: Scoped documentation review identifies no discussion of model influence on decisions and consequences of errors.
rules.detection_criteria: Reviewed package; explicit negative marker and no countervailing risk rationale
rules.required_evidence: Explicit scoped review of model influence and consequences of error, no contrary positive evidence.
rules.example: Model card says no model risk assessment is documented
rules.severity_rationale: Documentation or attachment is unclear or unavailable within the small uploaded package; requires follow-up.

expected_output.recommendation: Document model influence, decision consequences, mitigations and human oversight.

rules.name: Unresolved cited attachment
rules.scientific_meaning: A document cites a named attachment absent from the authoritative list of provided files.
rules.detection_criteria: Reference quote and backend-provided filenames; not a model guess
rules.required_evidence: Referenced attachment name and full authoritative uploaded document inventory from server.
rules.example: external_site_results.pdf is cited but not uploaded
rules.severity_rationale: Documentation or attachment is unclear or unavailable within the small uploaded package; requires follow-up.

expected_output.recommendation: Upload the cited file or update/remove the reference; absence refers only to analyzed package.

rules.regulatory_status: Scientific/document consistency check; no invented FDA legal requirement
